name: Xiaomi, Redmi and POCO (MIUI and HyperOS)

packages.label: Wallpaper Carousel (Glance for Mi)
packages.reason: Rotates lock-screen wallpapers with stories and ads on top. Your own wallpaper stays.

packages.label: MSA (MIUI System Ads)
packages.reason: Xiaomi's ad service. It serves the ads inside Xiaomi's own apps and install screens.

packages.label: System Ad Solution
packages.reason: The same ad service under its China-ROM name.

packages.label: Analytics
packages.reason: Sends usage statistics to Xiaomi, including for ad targeting. Nothing you use depends on it.

packages.label: App Vault
packages.reason: The swipe-left screen of shortcuts, news and sponsored cards.

packages.label: App Vault (older name)
packages.reason: App Vault on older MIUI versions: the swipe-left feed with sponsored cards.

packages.label: Quick Apps
packages.reason: Runs web mini-apps and pushes promoted ones. Google Play Protect once flagged it.

packages.label: Quick Apps helper
packages.reason: Support files for Quick Apps. Useless once Quick Apps is off.

packages.label: Games
packages.reason: Xiaomi's preinstalled games hub. Games you installed keep working.

packages.label: Feedback
packages.reason: Sends bug reports to Xiaomi. You only need it if Xiaomi support asks for a report.

packages.label: MIUI Daemon
packages.reason: Background service that collects device data. Widely turned off, but it is a core MIUI service.

packages.label: GetApps
packages.reason: Xiaomi's app store. Sends app promos, but also updates some Xiaomi apps.

packages.label: Cleaner
packages.reason: The cleaner screen that shows ads after a scan. The Security app itself keeps working.

packages.label: Mi Video
packages.reason: Video player with ads. Turn it off only if another app plays your videos.

packages.label: Mi Music
packages.reason: Music player with ads and a news feed. Turn it off if you use another music app.

packages.label: Mi Browser
packages.reason: Browser with ads and news pushes. Set Chrome or another browser as default first.

packages.label: Joyose
packages.reason: Cloud-tuned performance profiles that also report data. Games may run hotter or slower without it.
